key_insight: ShotStream reframes long video generation as a causal, next-shot streaming task: generate each upcoming shot conditioned only on past context and live user prompts, enabling real-time, interactive multi-shot narratives with far lower latency than bidirectional pipelines.
problem_solved: Current multi-shot video generators use bidirectional or full-context architectures that are slow, non-interactive, and ill-suited to on-the-fly user instruction for ongoing stories; ShotStream solves low interactivity and high latency in long-form narrative generation.
method: Causal next-shot generation: treat video as a sequence of shots and generate each new shot autoregressively conditioned on a compact representation of historical shots and streaming text prompts.

Shot-level memory and cross-shot attention: maintain a lightweight temporal memory of past shots and use targeted cross-shot attention to preserve coherence across generated segments without reprocessing the entire sequence.
Low-latency frame synthesis: incorporate an efficient decoder and incremental frame rendering pipeline to produce frames on-the-fly for interactive user control and rapid turn-taking.
impact: Enables real-time, interactive storytelling and efficient long-form video generation workflows, lowering latency and making multi-shot narrative systems practical for creative tools, games, and live content generation.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: left-to-right flow showing historical shots → shot memory → streaming prompt → next-shot generator → low-latency frame renderer
Latency comparison chart: bars comparing ShotStream vs. bidirectional baselines (inference time per shot / end-to-end latency)
Timeline visualization: sequence of shots with arrows showing causal conditioning and maintained temporal coherence
Interface mockup: interactive example where user edits streaming prompts and the system updates the next shot in real time
paper_title: ShotStream: Streaming Multi-Shot Video Generation for Interactive Storytelling
paper_authors: Yawen Luo, Xiaoyu Shi, Junhao Zhuang, Yutian Chen, Quande Liu
